name: Rogue River
agency: BLM Medford District / Rogue River-Siskiyou National Forest
note: Starter record: reach, mileage (from Grave Creek) and put-in/take-out only (coordinates approximate). Wild section floats require a BLM permit in the summer season. Add rapids, camps and lodges from your guidebook with the editor on the Rivers tab, or import a river JSON.

items.d: Apply on Recreation.gov from December 1 to January 31 for the regulated season. Check the BLM page for the current window; one older guide gives a January 15 close.
The per-person fee is due no later than 10 days before launch.

BLM lists open dates and space counts daily from May 5 to October 15. Call 541-479-3735 between 8 a.m. and 3 p.m. Day-of-launch permits go first-come, or by waiting list, at the Smullin Visitor Center at Rand.
From October 16 to May 14 you self-issue a permit at the drop boxes at Grave Creek (north end of the bridge) and the Smullin Visitor Center.
BLM and the Forest Service allow 120 people a day to launch. The cap counts people, not groups.
Grave Creek to Watson Creek, with Foster Bar as the take-out.
Missing the cancellation deadline makes you a no-show. You cannot hold a float permit for the rest of that year or through the next year's lottery and regulated season.
